_note: Shared vocabulary for reasoning-effort words, used only to DISPLAY and ORDER them in the Admin panel. Each hop keeps the exact words its provider accepts and sends those as-is. Researched 2026-10-16 from the providers' own docs (links under 'sources'). No synonyms are defined: none of the sources use 'mid' or similar for 'medium'. A synonym is added only once a doc, a paste or a test confirms two words mean the same thing. Never pruned when models are deleted. Unknown words are shown as typed.

levels.label: None
levels.seen: Turns reasoning off where supported: OpenRouter ('none', rejected by Anthropic models and by models flagged mandatory), OpenAI (model-dependent), Gemini ('none' only on 2.5 models), Z.ai glm-5.2 ('none'/'minimal' skip thinking), DeepSeek Responses API.

levels.label: Minimal
levels.seen: OpenRouter (about 10% of max_tokens; sent to Anthropic as 'low'), OpenAI, Gemini, Z.ai glm-5.2, DeepSeek (maps to 'low').

levels.label: Low
levels.seen: Everywhere: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Z.ai, DeepSeek.

levels.label: Medium
levels.seen: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini. Z.ai glm-5.2 and DeepSeek accept it but treat it as 'high'. Z.ai glm-5.3 does NOT list it.

levels.label: High
levels.seen: Everywhere. Default for DeepSeek V4 and most Anthropic models.

levels.label: X-High
levels.seen: OpenRouter (same allocation as 'max'; mapped down to 'high' on Gemini 3), OpenAI, Anthropic (some models only), Z.ai glm-5.2 (maps to 'max'), DeepSeek (maps to 'high').

levels.label: Max
levels.seen: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Z.ai (default; the only values for glm-5.3 are low/high/max), DeepSeek V4.

otherModesSeen: Token budget instead of words: Gemini 2.5 thinking_budget; OpenRouter reasoning.max_tokens.
Thinking switch only: DeepSeek and Z.ai thinking.type = enabled/disabled; NVIDIA templates use enable_thinking or thinking (true/false).
Three-state mode: MiniMax M3 thinking_mode = disabled/adaptive/enabled (via a third-party NVIDIA NIM extension README, unverified).
Word with no level meaning: DeepSeek's docs map 'ultra' to 'max'.
